 Follow Andrew Garfield & Monica Barbaro Hold Hands While Leaving GQ’s Men of the Year Party Together
 Kim Brown Updated Fri, November 13, 2026 at 3:32 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Getty Images Andrew Garfield and Monica Barbaro had a date night last night!
 The pair were seen holding hands while exiting the 2026 GQ Men of the Year Party on Thursday night (November 12) held at the Chateau Marmont in Los Angeles.
 If you don't know, Andrew was one of the honorees at the event.
 He was named the "Performer of the Year" by the mag for their annual edition.
 How Long Have Andrew Garfield and Monica Barbaro Been Dating?
 It was first confirmed back in February 2025 that Andrew and Monica were dating, after they had been spotted together at multiple awards season events.
 In early 2026, it was confirmed they were still together. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In August 2026, Monica made a rare comment about their relationship. 
 FYI: Andrew is wearing Edward Sexton with a Breguet watch. Monica is wearing Brandon Maxwell , Aquazzura shoes, and Leviev and Arielle Ratner jewels.
